name: Vladimir Friedman
bio: Vladimir Friedman was born on 20 June 1959 in Kursk, Russia. He is an actor, known for American Assassin (2017), Golden Voices (2019) and Hold Me Tightly (2024).
place: Kursk, Kurskaya oblast, RSFSR, USSR [now Russia]
